description: Submit a publicly reachable audio or video URL for copyright screening. Returns immediately with a report_id and QUEUED status — call get_screening to poll for the result. Costs credits from the account that owns the API key (1 credit per sampled window). Run this BEFORE publishing generated content.

filename.description: Original filename, used to determine the format (e.g. track.mp3)

url.description: Publicly reachable https URL of the audio or video file

name: screen_audio
title: Screen audio or video for copyright matches
